title: ASTM C 636, Section 2.
officialText:
1.7. Delete Section 2.1.7 and replace as follows:
2.1.7 Carrying channels shall be attached to hangers in a manner that will prevent any vertical movement or rotation. If hangers
are secured to special attachment devices that support the carrying channels, such devices shall have certified load test data from
an approved testing agency and shall be capable of carrying four times the design load.
